sentences.text:
Through: Mr

 versus
 State Nct Of Delhi 
 Through: Ms
 Si
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Girish Kathpalia
 Order
1 .  Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
CRL.M.A. 22801/2025 (delay in filing ( 53 days )
2. For the reasons mentioned therein, the application seeking condonation of delay in filing the appeal is condoned.
Application stands disposed of.
CRL.M.(BAIL) 1664/2025 (suspension of sentence)

3. The appellant has assailed his conviction for offence under Section 376(2)(n) IPC, for which the sentence awarded was ten years rigorous imprisonment and Rs. 3,13,595/- fine; for offence under Section 384 IPC, the sentence awarded was two years rigorous imprisonment and Rs. 50,000/- fine;
and for offence under Section 506 II IPC, the sentence awarded was This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 06/08/2025 at 22:51:13 five years rigorous imprisonment and Rs. 1,00,000/- fine.
As on date, the appellant is stated to have already suffered imprisonment for about four years and nine months.
4. Learned APP accepts notice.
5. Digitized record of trial court be requisitioned before the next date of hearing.
6. Reply to the suspension of sentence be filed within four weeks.
GIRISH KATHPALIA, J AUGUST 6, 2025/
